items.text: At least six people are killed and ten others are injured after a fresh outbreak of clan violence in the Galgaduud region of Somalia. ((Hiiraan Online))
The Holy Family Church in Gaza City of the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem is hit by Israel, with three deaths and nine injuries. ((BBC News))

At least 69 people are killed, 11 are reported missing, and 43 others are injured in a fire at a shopping mall in Kut, Wasit Governorate, Iraq. The Iraqi government declares three days of mourning and the provincial government files lawsuits against the owners of the mall. ((Reuters)) ((CNN)) ((NDTV))

At least four people are killed, two others are seriously injured and more than 1,000 others are evacuated after torrential rainfall submerges buildings and causes a landslide in Gyeonggi and South Chungcheong provinces, South Korea. ((Reuters)) ((The Korea Herald))
A child is killed and 21 people are injured in a coach crash in Somerset, England. ((BBC News))
Record-breaking daredevil and skydiver Felix Baumgartner dies in a paragliding accident in Porto Sant'Elpidio, Italy. A woman on the ground is also injured in the accident. ((ABC News))
The Ukrainian parliament appoints Yulia Svyrydenko as the new prime minister, succeeding Denys Shmyhal. ((Reuters))
Three people are killed and nine others are injured when Israel strikes the Holy Family Church in Gaza City, the only Catholic church in Gaza. ((BBC News))
A child is killed and 21 people are injured when a coach bus crashes in Somerset, England. ((BBC News))
The United Kingdom announces it will lower the voting age to 16, allowing 16- and 17-year-olds to vote in the upcoming next general election. ((NPR))
